title: Dirichlet's Approximation Theorem via Minkowski's Lattice Point Theorem

problemStatement.formal: For any real alpha and positive integer Q, prove there exist integers p,q with 1 <= q <= Q and |q*alpha - p| < 1/Q, using Minkowski lattice points.
problemStatement.plain: Derive Dirichlet approximation from Minkowski theorem using a parallelogram argument.
whyMatters: Shows a classic bridge between Diophantine approximation and the geometry of numbers
Identifies the exact three geometric facts still axiomatized in this version

proven: The Dirichlet parallelogram is centrally symmetric.
The main approximation theorem follows from Minkowski once convexity, measurability, and volume are assumed.
The q != 0 extraction and rational approximation corollary are proved.
open: Eliminate the three measure-theoretic axioms, as done in the OQ02-OQ01 successor.
Generalize to simultaneous approximation and Hurwitz-type refinements.
knownResults.goal: Record the completed axiomatized Minkowski proof of Dirichlet approximation.
